mapper.sql: select recharge_order_no,member_id,recharge_money,status,real_name, recharge_real_name,bank_user_name,bank_id,bank_account, bank_address,op_name,remark, `first`, create_time, update_time, ip, discount_bill from member_recharge_bank
mapper.select: select COUNT(1) from member_recharge_bank where date(update_time) = curdate() and member_id = #{memberId} and status = 3;

select w.recharge_money money, w.recharge_order_no orderNo, w.create_time requestTime, l.bank_name bankName, w.`status`, w.remark from member_recharge_bank w left join config_bank_list l on l.id = w.bank_id where w.member_id = #{memberId} and w.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 15 DAY) order by w.create_time desc
